scenes.area: The Grand Hall of the Temple
scenes.location: The Grand Hall of the Temple

events.text: Báyakan listened at the door and opened it.
Dart trap monster parts were added to the party stash.
The party entered room 5, The Grand Hall of the Temple.
Doopa talked about the maze they made.
Natalia cast Rousing Splash on party members.
Changer stepped onto the unfinished floor and it held.
Changer opened the door to reveal a swarm of blood seekers feasting on corpses.
Combat started against the blood seekers.

scenes.area: The Grand Hall of the Temple
scenes.location: The Grand Hall of the Temple

events.text: Chase killed a blood seeker with a pulse of sound.
Akuma killed the final bug to end combat.
The party found a key on one of the human worker corpses.
The party opened the safe and found 45 gold pieces.
Bayakan noticed that the statue of the antlered old woman was rigged to spew fire.

scenes.area: The Grand Hall of the Temple

events.text: Bayakan noticed several points where standing on the wood could result in a fall.
The party walked across the hallway safely.

scenes.area: The Grand Hall of the Temple

events.text: Nadya examined the bodies and confirmed they were dead and not killed recently.

scenes.area: The Grand Hall of the Temple

events.text: Changer discussed saving Magnimarian citizens.
Changer stated he would await the party at the door.
Changer stood at the doorway.
Nadya briefly tossed the bodies and stood ready to move on.

scenes.area: The Grand Hall of the Temple

events.text: The party moved onto room 9.
A plaque named room 9 as the hall of wisdom.
Báyakan Tiktik rolled 20 on a perception check.
Báyakan Tiktik succeeded VS DC 19.
Chase Darkthorne pointed out the snare and sent an ultrasonic pulse into the webbed area.
A female kobold scout on her spider mount was revealed hiding in the webbing.
Báyakan suggested someone physically tough go through first.

scenes.area: The Grand Hall of the Temple

events.text: Changer expressed a desire for a structural change after the mission.
Rex arrived at the room as backup sent from the lieutenant.
Changer pointed down the hallway toward the opponents.
Steele arrived at the scene as a former sergeant of the Magnimar City Guard.
Kitt introduced themselves as being on assignment from the Chaplain Unit.
Rex cautiously walked into the doorway.
Chase Darkthorne noted the snare trap across the threshold and the spider mounted kobold.

scenes.area: The Grand Hall of the Temple

events.text: Chase Darkthorne disarmed a snare trap in the doorway.
A crossbow bolt was launched at Chase when the trap was disabled.
Combat started against the kobold and spider in the chamber.
Kitt restricted the kobold Kreski's movement with a tangle vine.
Chase Darkthorne cast a spell dealing damage to the spider Margle.
Rex shot the spider Margle with a crossbow for 3 damage.
